description:
The site's Guides: evergreen buying-guide pages served at /guides/{id}, stored in the roundups collection. Returns every guide in display order with its id, heading, lede, reviewed date and draft flag. A guide's full content (contenders, choose, howToChoose, faqs, sources) is on the object itself: get_object with collection "roundups".

Returns: paginated roundups objects with url per item.
name: list_guides

has_more.description: True when total > offset + count(items); call again with offset += limit to paginate.

items.description: Matching roundups objects, each decorated with a `url` field where the collection has a public URL pattern configured. Field set varies by collection — call describe_collection for the schema.

url.description: Public URL for this object when the collection has a URL pattern configured.

limit.description: Cap applied to this response — server may have lowered the requested limit.
